name: claude-model-presets
description: Keyboard shortcuts that switch model and effort on claude.ai in one step (unofficial).

scripts.start:firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start:chrome: npm run build && web-ext run --target chromium --source-dir dist/chrome
scripts.start:floorp: npm run build && web-ext run --firefox=/usr/bin/floorp --firefox-profile=/home/david/.local/share/claude-model-presets-profile --profile-create-if-missing --keep-profile-changes --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build && web-ext sign --channel=unlisted --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts
